payload.description: As a Plexus user, I want a JevScore to declare elements (sub-questions answered in the same single Jev request) and a decision model that turns element answers plus Jev's holistic answer into the final value and a confidence, so that scores can be fine-tuned from human feedback. Phase 1 covers the schema, feature extraction, question namespacing, and hand-authorable linear serving. Not included: fitting, calibration, optimizer integration. Definition of Done: specs pass with a mocked client; without elements or decision, behavior is unchanged.
payload.title: Jev decision head: elements, features, serving
